Add a plan configurator or premium plan cards (with specs), a specs/feature showcase, a NetworkMap/latency touch, compact reviews, the 47s hook. This is the page most buyers convert on — make it the strongest.

**Template 2 — Business email (`/preview/business-email`, component under `components/marketing/emailtemplate/`):** professional email on your own domain. Hero: an animated inbox (evolve `MailInbox` showcase — messages arriving, a clean branded inbox). The story: deliverability/sender-reputation, your-own-domain, per-mailbox pricing. **Business email** — asymmetric hero with an animated **live inbox** (evolution of the `MailInbox` showcase, wrapped in the shared `ScreenFrame`): messages arrive on top with a fresh-highlight, pulsing unread dots, an "N new" counter, and a "Sender score 99" live badge. Then: buying-story bento, a **deliverability section** (an inbox-placement ring that counts up + SPF/DKIM/DMARC rows that check-pop in), a **per-mailbox price comparison** anchoring Nxeon $2 against Google Workspace $7 and Zoho $3 (Nxeon highlighted, "Best value"), a domain-integration band reusing the `DnsManager` showcase, per-mailbox plan cards, reviews, and CTA.
